description: Failure-path tests for the v3 consumer migration. Asserts malformed v3 tuples, SIGINT during capture, and review-after-cancel all fail closed: no partial profile is committed, the session is cancelled, and the CLI exits cleanly.

tests.setup: FakeEnrollmentServiceV3 configured to return EnrollmentError::MalformedTuple from review()
tests.asserts: driver surfaces the malformed-tuple error, calls cancel, returns V3Outcome::Discarded; commit is never called so no partial profile can result

tests.setup: cancel_flag set to true before the driver enters the capture loop (simulates SIGINT received during capture)
tests.asserts: driver calls cancel, returns V3Outcome::Discarded; stop/review/commit never run; clean exit without panic

tests.setup: fake bus server dropped before review so the review call fails on the transport layer
tests.asserts: bridge surfaces KcmError::DaemonUnavailable or KcmError::Call; no commit attempted; no partial profile visible to v1 ListProfiles

tests.setup: fake v3 service with no committed profiles
tests.asserts: list_profiles is empty after cancel; review-after-cancel returns KcmError::Call (session gone), not a stale review

tests.setup: fake v3 service with session in Capturing phase (not Stopped)
tests.asserts: review returns KcmError::Call because the session is in Capturing, not Stopped; daemon enforces the stop-before-review contract

invariants.no_partial_profile_on_failure: Every failure path (malformed tuple, SIGINT, transport loss, wrong-phase review) calls cancel or surfaces an error before commit. No code path writes a profile when review/commit did not succeed.
invariants.sigint_clean_exit: SIGINT sets an AtomicBool checked at the top of every capture-loop iteration; the driver calls cancel and returns V3Outcome::Discarded without panicking.
invariants.review_requires_stopped: The daemon (and the fake) reject ReviewEnrollment when the session is not in the Stopped phase, enforcing the Stop→Review→Commit checkpoint.
